description: This Java class 'EcuAddressImpl' implements the 'EcuAddress' interface and provides functionality for managing ECU addresses, including address building, byte conversion, and address padding.

classes.name: EcuAddressImpl
classes.description: Final class implementing EcuAddress interface, managing ECU address data including address array, byte array, and bit position.

methods.name: EcuAddressImpl
methods.description: Constructors for initializing ECU address with single address, address array, or default addresses.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Returns the array of address strings.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Returns the byte array representation of the addresses.

methods.name: getBit
methods.description: Returns the bit position associated with the address.

methods.name: buildAddresses
methods.description: Builds a list of address strings based on starting address and desired length.

methods.name: padAddress
methods.description: Pads an address string with leading zeros to match specified length.

methods.name: getAddressBytes
methods.description: Converts address strings into a concatenated byte array.
